children: Overview
Hong Kong renewable energy firm's half-year revenue rose 340.8% yr/yr to HK$3.59 bln
Profit attributable to owners surged to HK$58 mln from HK$15.1 mln a year ago
No interim dividend declared for the six months ended 30 September 2026
Outlook
Envision Greenwise expects gross margin to benefit from profitable recycling growth and full-period intelligent-computing consolidation
Result Drivers
CLOUD ACQUISITION – July acquisition of Cloud Calculation Group added HK$39.4 mln of intelligent-computing revenue and HK$1.9 mln of profit
CONSTRUCTION PROJECT COMPLETION – Superstructure and RMAA revenue fell to HK$6.9 mln from HK$25.7 mln after a major project was completed and other projects reached completion stage
LOGISTICS AND HANDLING COSTS – Selling and distribution expenses rose to HK$138.9 mln from HK$20.8 mln on higher handling and logistics costs tied to industrial-materials trading volumes
